goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Scheduling/Dispatch owns feasible fulfilment commitments, assignment, capacity, routing execution and operational recovery after work enters fulfilment.
Customer Access retains ownership of general access/customer-entry outcomes; Access Failure Prevention collaborates into dispatch without being redefined or re-parented.
Field Quality/Readiness owns first-time-fix preparation and field execution quality; Supply owns inventory/equipment continuity; Customer Care owns service recovery/retention communications.
Route algorithms, maps, calendars, channels and predictive models are tools/capabilities, not separate workforce identities.
Service Delivery Flow Orchestrator owns accepted-work fulfilment coherence; Customer Journey Access Orchestrator owns customer-entry coherence; Revenue Growth Orchestrator owns commercial growth.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
